text:
Root cause: `wrap_after` used `>=`, causing a line whose content exactly reached the configured limit to wrap prematurely.

Changed both identifier-list and function-argument wrapping checks in `reindent.py` to wrap only when the calculated position exceeds the limit.

Root cause: `wrap_after` used `>=`, causing a line whose content exactly reached the configured limit to wrap prematurely.

Changed both identifier-list and function-argument wrapping checks in `reindent.py` to wrap only when the calculated position exceeds the limit.
